style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Today Salvation Has Come
images.concept: The one who climbed to see — found before he finished looking, called down from his perch
images.imageAlt: The forked branch of a large sycamore fig tree, the leaves casting dappled shadow below, the branch itself worn smooth where it bends
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, the forked branch of a large ancient fig tree seen from below, the thick branch worn smooth at its bend, the broad leaves casting dappled shadow patterns downward, warm filtered light coming through the canopy, no people — just the branch and the light through leaves, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm green and amber palette of leaves and dark bark and filtered light, Alabaster Books upward attention, 16:9 with the branch occupying the upper frame and the dappled light patterns falling below, the elevated place from which everything is about to change

images.title: Invest Until I Return
images.concept: Entrusted wealth and the reckoning — faithfulness measured in multiplication, not preservation
images.imageAlt: A row of simple clay jars on a stone shelf, one jar conspicuously empty and set apart, the others sealed, warm side light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a row of simple unglazed clay storage jars on a rough stone shelf, most sealed with cloth stoppers, one jar at the end clearly empty and slightly apart from the others as if set aside, warm raking side light from the left picking out the texture of the clay surfaces, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of pale clay and rough stone, Kinfolk material inventory, 16:9 with the row of jars extending horizontally and the single empty one distinguished at the right, the unused and the used side by side

images.title: The King Comes on a Donkey
images.concept: Cloaks spread on the road — the unexpected mode of a king's arrival
images.imageAlt: A road covered in strewn palm branches and cloaks, the path leading uphill toward a distant gate, warm light across the scattered layers
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a stone road with scattered palm fronds and pieces of rough cloth spread across its surface, the layers irregular and covering the road from edge to edge, the road curving uphill toward a city gate barely visible at the top of the rise, warm golden light raking across the strewn path, the cloth and fronds creating a patchwork of textures, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of pale stone and dried green and faded fabric, Alabaster Books processional weight, 16:9 with the strewn road filling the lower two-thirds and the city gate at the hill's crest in the upper third

images.title: If You Had Known
images.concept: The city seen from the Mount of Olives — beauty that does not know the hour of its visitation
images.imageAlt: A distant view of a walled city on a hill from a hillside opposite, olive trees in the foreground, afternoon haze softening the walls
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a distant view across a valley of a walled city on a hill, the city's stone walls glowing in afternoon light, dark cypress or olive trees in the near foreground slightly out of focus, afternoon haze softening the far walls and making them appear almost dreamlike, the valley between filled with pale air, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the haze, muted warm palette of pale city stone and dark olive trees and blue-white haze, Kinfolk landscape longing, 16:9 with the foreground trees in the lower third and the city floating on the hill in the upper center

images.title: A House of Prayer
images.concept: The temple reclaimed — the marketplace cleared and the house of prayer restored
images.imageAlt: A large empty stone courtyard at midday, a single overturned clay pot and scattered grain on the pale stone, deep shadows at the edges
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a large empty stone courtyard at harsh midday, in the center of the pale stone floor a single overturned clay pot with scattered grain around it — the aftermath of a clearing — the courtyard otherwise empty and open, strong shadows from unseen walls pressing in at the edges, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, near-monochrome palette of pale stone and deep edge shadows with the overturned pot as the only sign of disruption, Alabaster Books austere stillness, 16:9 with the overturned pot in the center of vast empty stone and darkness at the periphery
